name: image-to-editable-pptx
description: Reconstruct PNG and JPEG slide images as high-fidelity PPTX files with editable text and safe semantic layers.

interface.shortDescription: Turn PNG and JPEG slides into editable PPTX files.
interface.longDescription: Reconstruct PNG or JPEG slides with editable OCR text and safely extracted PNG layers, using existing local OpenCodex accounts, optional registered-tool bridges, or provider APIs with Alibaba fallback.
interface.defaultPrompt: Convert this slide image into a high-fidelity editable PPTX using automatic local OpenCodex discovery, an explicit registered-tool bridge when available, and the documented API fallback order ending with Alibaba. Verify actual provider results; never infer access from missing API keys or model listings alone.
